risks.risk: Untrusted document or tool description induces a different write action
risks.control: Fixed action and field allowlist at gate; no instruction parsing from note
risks.residual: Malicious but valid-looking finding content still needs expert review

risks.control: Tenant in validated actor token must match target tenant; register authorization remains required in production
risks.residual: Misconfigured issuer or downstream register ACL is not covered by lab

risks.control: Signature, audience, expiry and narrow finding:write scope checked before write
risks.residual: Teaching HMAC issuer is not production OIDC; stolen key remains critical

risks.risk: Self-approval or approval reused for changed content
risks.control: Distinct reviewer; signed exact proposal hash; expiry and single-use approval identifier
risks.residual: Reviewer may approve factually incorrect content

risks.control: Transactional request-id uniqueness; same payload returns idempotent result; changed payload conflicts
risks.residual: Cross-system side effects would need a distributed idempotency contract

risks.risk: Secret or personal content leaks through audit and execution data
risks.control: Audit stores decision and proposal hash, not tokens/content; n8n lab execution persistence disabled
risks.residual: HTTP transport, proxy logs, backups and downstream systems need separate review

risks.risk: Compromised community node or container version changes behaviour
risks.control: Production intake requires pinned digest, package inventory, advisory review and rollback owner
risks.evidence: Chapter 41 approval table; deployment inventory required before production
risks.residual: Lab does not attest image signatures or supply-chain provenance

risks.risk: Unreviewed legal applicability or retention creates noncompliant processing
risks.control: Privacy/legal intake records role, purpose, data inventory, jurisdiction and current official legal text
risks.evidence: Chapter 41 regulatory mapping and dated source register
risks.residual: Technical lab is not legal advice or a compliance certification
